gray_areas.question: Should three-time event semantics enter the first wave?
gray_areas.recommendation: Require event_time, available_at and decision_time or N/A-with-reason; available_at > decision_time must fail closed.

gray_areas.question: Should event-study methods be slot-only contracts or a full statistics library?
gray_areas.recommendation: Define estimation window, event window, normal return model, CAR/BHAR and calendar-time slots; do not implement a full statistics library in CR153.

gray_areas.question: How should test family, overlapping events, clustering and endogeneity be audited?
gray_areas.recommendation: Use structured slots, status, refs, sample count, adjusted p-value and n/a-with-reason; unsupported methods must be NEEDS_REVIEW or BLOCKED.

gray_areas.question: How should Event admission gate relate to CR151 and CR152 gates?
gray_areas.recommendation: Create an Event-specific gate plus adapter and reuse four-state admission semantics and package linkage.

gray_areas.question: Does event-to-order trace authorize runtime, order or broker access?
gray_areas.recommendation: No. Define only event -> signal -> target/order-intent trace contract.

gray_areas.question: Should CV and survivorship be fully governed in CR153?
gray_areas.recommendation: CR153 only reserves event CV slot, split audit refs and universe_pit_audit slot; full governance is deferred to CR154.
